description:
🦠 Scrub Typhus: Ticks, Mites, Fleas and the Truth Behind the Disease 🧬
In this video, we dive deep into the confusing world of ticks, mites, and fleas — and set the record straight about scrub typhus, a serious but often misunderstood vector-borne disease. Many believe it’s caused by ticks, but the truth is very different.

👉 Learn how scrub typhus is caused by the bacterium Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by the larvae of trombiculid mites (commonly known as chiggers) — not ticks!
🕷️ We’ll clearly explain the differences between ticks, mites, and fleas.
🔍 Understand how this disease spreads, recognize key symptoms, and learn why accurate knowledge is essential for timely diagnosis and treatment.
#ScrubTyphus #TicksVsMites #Fleas #OrientiaTsutsugamushi #MiteLarvae #HealthEducation #VectorBorneDisease
This video is a must-watch for anyone interested in public health, infectious diseases, or simply busting myths around common parasites.
